s0.title: Welcome to AutoToDo
s0.subtitle: Meeting notes become action items automatically.
s0.desc: AutoToDo reads your meeting transcripts and uses AI to extract all tasks, owners and deadlines. Log your daily plan each morning — and by month-end your activity report fills itself.

s1.title: Step 1 – Create a project
s1.subtitle: One project per client or team.
s1.desc: Click "New project" on the dashboard. Enter a name and an optional description. Optionally select a German state — public holidays will then be hidden automatically in the activity report.

s2.title: Step 2 – Upload transcript
s2.subtitle: Copy & paste or file upload.
s2.desc: Open a project and click »↑ Upload Transcript«. You can paste text directly, upload a .txt or .rtf file – or import a Notion page directly. The AI processing starts automatically.

s3.title: Step 3 – AI extracts tasks
s3.subtitle: Fully automatic – in seconds.
s3.desc: The AI (Anthropic, OpenAI or Azure) analyses the transcript and creates action items with title, owner, due date, priority and status. Uncertain items are flagged for review.

s4.title: Step 4 – Edit the action list
s4.subtitle: Filter, edit, co-owners & links.
s4.desc: Filter by status, priority and owner. Click a title to edit all details — including co-owners and external links. You can also add new items manually at any time.

s5.title: Step 5 – Daily planning
s5.subtitle: What are you working on today?
s5.desc: Click »Daily plan« and note what you plan to do today. The AI uses these entries for your activity report. When everyone on the call shares their plan, the report becomes even more accurate.

s6.title: Step 6 – Activity report
s6.subtitle: Auto-filled monthly log.
s6.desc: The activity report shows all working days — automatically filled from your LOP items and daily plans. Entries are editable and can be printed as a PDF or exported directly as an XLSX file.

s7.title: Step 7 – Discover more
s7.subtitle: Global search, AI summary, templates & archive.
s7.desc: Press ⌘K (Mac) or Ctrl+K to open global search across all projects. »✦ AI Summary« generates a quick overview of all open items in a project. »☰ Apply template« lets you kick off new projects with pre-built task packages. »↓ Export archive« downloads completed items as XLSX.
